privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introductionText: At TypingFlow, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring transparency about how we handle your data. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding your personal data.
privacy.localStorageDescription: TypingFlow stores your typing test results, personal bests, and settings locally in your browser. This data never leaves your device and is not transmitted to our servers.

privacy.improvePerformance: Improve the application's performance and user experience
privacy.analyzeUsage: Analyze usage patterns to develop new features
privacy.ensureSecurity: Ensure the security and stability of our service
privacy.dataSecurityDescription: Your typing data is stored locally in your browser using secure web storage APIs. We implement industry-standard security measures to protect any data that may be transmitted:

privacy.thirdPartyPolicies: These services have their own privacy policies and data handling practices.
privacy.clearLocalData: Clear your local data at any time through the settings
privacy.disableTracking: Disable analytics tracking in your browser
privacy.useWithoutPersonalInfo: Use the application without providing any personal information
privacy.policyUpdatesDescription: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Last modified" date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
privacy.noDataCollectionDescription: Important: TypingFlow is designed as a privacy-first application. We do not collect, store, or transmit any personal information. All your typing data remains on your device and is never sent to external servers. You can use this application with complete confidence in your privacy.
